$comment: Every official page a statutory form is copied from. scripts/capture-statutes.mjs fetches each URL and writes the bytes the server sent, untouched, to statutes/raw/<id>.html beside a <id>.meta.json naming the final URL, the status, the retrieval time and the SHA-256 of those bytes. Nothing in this app reads a statute from anywhere else. Official legislature sites only -- never a vendor blog.

sources.citation: Cal. Civ. Code §§ 8120–8138 (Div. 4, Pt. 6, Title 1, Ch. 3: Waiver and Release)
sources.why: leginfo answers 403 to GitHub's runners, with or without a browser user-agent.
The site is a JavaScript app; a plain fetch returns its empty shell.
